name: kestrix
description: Security checks for the code Claude writes: after every edit, the local kestrix-scan scanner checks the changed file for insecure code in 13 languages and hard-coded secrets, and Claude fixes the findings. Also checks package installs against a local OSV index (denies known-malicious packages), plus secure-review skills and /kestrix:scan, /kestrix:fix and /kestrix:review. Runs locally; needs the kestrix-scan (or kestrix) command on PATH.
